# Sell My Company Data — service reference

Website: https://sellmycompanydata.com/
Brand name: Sell My Company Data

## What the business does
Sell My Company Data helps companies explore licensing de-identified business workflow records to AI labs and research teams. Potential records include support tickets, internal messages, contracts, invoices, reconciliation records, procedures and project documentation. Availability and eligibility require rights, permissions and scope review; a listed data category is not a guarantee of inventory.

## Sellers
A company can use the free indicative calculator and then submit a booking enquiry. The enquiry asks for contact/company details, the connection to the data and optional context. Calculator answers are included when the enquiry is submitted. Changing calculator inputs alone does not submit a lead or upload business records. Booking proceeds through https://cal.com/jamesrowdyy/15min.

## Calculator
Base pricing is Handshake AI's published data-partnership calculator, read 2026-10-11. Value = $140,000 + $2,333 per employee + $11,667 per year of operation + $15.75 per GB of records. Low bound = 0.75 x value; high bound = 1.25 x value; both x a country factor (US 1.00, Canada 0.75, UK and Europe 0.75, Australia, New Zealand and elsewhere 0.30), then x 1.01 rounded up. Below 50 staff the low bound is reduced by up to $69,102 x country factor (full at 20 staff, none at 50+). Employees count up to 200 and years up to 20; above either the range ends with a plus sign.
Records: the low bound assumes 1 GB per employee-year. The high bound rises with selected systems in equal steps from 1 GB (none) to 14 GB (six or more).
Qualifying bar: 20+ employees and 3+ years. Below it the calculator shows no number. Revenue and industry do not change the result.
Examples: 100 staff, 10 years, US, six systems = $383,083 to $896,969 (identical to Handshake's figure); same in Canada/UK/Europe = $287,313 to $672,727; same in Australia/NZ = $114,925 to $269,091; 50 staff, 10 years, US, three systems = $288,755 to $545,883; 20 staff, 3 years, US, no systems = $100,000 to $283,825. These are model outputs, not guaranteed prices or evidence of completed deals.
Methodology: https://sellmycompanydata.com/data-valuation/

## Licensing
A licence grants defined permission rather than transferring ownership. A written agreement must define records, permitted use, preparation, delivery and payment. De-identification alone does not establish a right to license data. No data access or licence is granted by an initial enquiry.
Guide: https://sellmycompanydata.com/data-licensing/

## Buyers
AI labs and research teams can submit a brief describing the records, sector, timeline and budget they are seeking. Scope, rights and delivery are discussed before a licence is agreed.
Buyer page: https://sellmycompanydata.com/buyers/

## Referrals
The advertised fee is a flat $10,000 for a qualifying completed licence. The fee, attribution, eligibility and payment conditions must be confirmed in writing before an introduction proceeds. Submission alone does not establish payment entitlement.
Referral page: https://sellmycompanydata.com/refer/
Terms: https://sellmycompanydata.com/terms/
Privacy: https://sellmycompanydata.com/privacy/
